claims.text: The universal, html/body and heading rules set box-sizing, margin, scrollbar-gutter and typography through design tokens.
The button, input, select, label, focus-visible, hidden and dialog rules provide native control chrome, focus outline and dialog treatment.
The prefers-reduced-motion media rule disables animation, transition and smooth scroll behavior.

decision.rule: Change here when the base reset, typography, control chrome or motion preferences need to change.
decision.failure: Controls render without focus visibility, dialogs overflow, or motion-sensitive users still receive animation.

questions.q: Where are the base reset and typography token rules defined?
Where should I change the focus-visible outline and dialog styling?
Where can I debug why controls still animate for reduced-motion users?
